package native

import (
	"debug/dwarf"
	"debug/elf"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

// Scratch only. Run from the committed runner, never part of the package gate.
func TestDebugPathsScratch(t *testing.T) {
	root := "/tmp/gd4csnt"
	if err := os.MkdirAll(root, 0755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	compiler, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(unitKeyCompiler(t))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	modes := []string{"baseline", "compilation-dir", "absolute-mapped", "absolute-relative", "relative-remapped", "relative-dot", "debugger-source-map"}
	for _, mode := range modes {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			var sources []string
			var keys [][]string
			for _, copy := range []string{"one", "two"} {
				entry := debugPathFixture(t, filepath.Join(root, mode, copy))
				program, err := debugProgram(t, entry, true)
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				source := CWithOptions(program, Options{Debug: true})
				directory := filepath.Join(root, mode, copy, "build")
				if err := os.MkdirAll(directory, 0755); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				flags := SourceFlags(source, Options{Debug: true})
				extra := []string{}
				keyExtra := []string{}
				switch mode {
				case "compilation-dir":
					extra = []string{"-fdebug-compilation-dir=" + filepath.Dir(entry)}
					keyExtra = extra
				case "absolute-mapped", "absolute-relative":
					source = strings.ReplaceAll(source, `"fixture.a"`, fmt.Sprintf("%q", entry))
					source = strings.ReplaceAll(source, `"../lib/value.a"`, fmt.Sprintf("%q", filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(entry), "../lib/value.a")))
					extra = []string{"-fdebug-prefix-map=" + filepath.Dir(filepath.Dir(entry)) + "=/adamic-source"}
					if mode == "absolute-relative" {
						extra = []string{"-fdebug-prefix-map=" + filepath.Dir(filepath.Dir(entry)) + "/="}
					}
					keyExtra = extra
				case "relative-remapped":
					extra = []string{"-fdebug-prefix-map=" + directory + "=" + filepath.Dir(entry)}
					// Match unitCompileArguments' normalization of its ephemeral directory.
					keyExtra = []string{"-fdebug-prefix-map=<directory>=" + filepath.Dir(entry)}
				case "relative-dot":
					extra = []string{"-fdebug-compilation-dir=."}
					keyExtra = extra
				}
				sources = append(sources, source)
				header, units, err := splitC(source)
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				common, err := readRuntime(runtime, "runtime")
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				common = append(common, runtimeFile{name: "units.h", contents: []byte(header)})
				keying := testUnitKeying(t, unitFirst, common, append(append([]string{}, flags...), keyExtra...), compiler, unitKeyEnvironment())
				var current []string
				for _, unit := range units {
					current = append(current, keying.key(unit))
					if why := unitSourceRefusal(unit, unitFirst); why != "" {
						t.Logf("%s cache refusal: %s", unit.name, why)
					}
				}
				keys = append(keys, current)
				t.Logf("%s %s flags=%q candidate unit keys=%v", mode, copy, extra, current)
				library, err := RuntimeLibraryForSource("", source, Options{Debug: true})
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(directory, "main.c"), []byte(source), 0644); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				binary := filepath.Join(directory, "program")
				arguments := append(append([]string{}, flags...), prefixMaps(directory, "/adamic-build")...)
				arguments = append(arguments, extra...)
				arguments = append(arguments, "-I", filepath.Dir(library), "main.c", library, "-lm", "-o", binary)
				command := clangIn(directory, compiler, arguments...)
				if output, err := command.CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
					t.Fatalf("clang: %v %s", err, output)
				}
				ok := debugSourcePaths(t, binary, entry)
				t.Logf("%s %s paths=%t", mode, copy, ok)
				if ok != (mode == "compilation-dir" || mode == "relative-remapped") {
					t.Fatalf("unexpected path result for %s: %t", mode, ok)
				}
				// An actual debugger-side mapping needs no compiler flags or changed keys.
				if mode == "debugger-source-map" {
					for _, relative := range []string{"fixture.a", "../lib/value.a"} {
						resolved := filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(entry), relative))
						_, err := os.Stat(resolved)
						t.Logf("debugger map /adamic-build -> %s: %s os.Stat=%v", filepath.Dir(entry), resolved, err)
					}
				}
				object, err := elf.Open(binary)
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				data, err := object.DWARF()
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				reader := data.Reader()
				symbolized := map[string]bool{}
				for {
					unit, err := reader.Next()
					if err != nil {
						t.Fatal(err)
					}
					if unit == nil {
						break
					}
					if unit.Tag != dwarf.TagCompileUnit {
						continue
					}
					lines, err := data.LineReader(unit)
					if err != nil {
						t.Fatal(err)
					}
					if lines == nil {
						continue
					}
					var row dwarf.LineEntry
					for {
						err := lines.Next(&row)
						if err == io.EOF {
							break
						}
						if err != nil {
							t.Fatal(err)
						}
						if row.EndSequence || row.File == nil || row.Line != 3 || !strings.HasSuffix(row.File.Name, ".a") || symbolized[row.File.Name] {
							continue
						}
						symbolized[row.File.Name] = true
						output, err := exec.Command(filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(compiler), "llvm-symbolizer"), "--obj="+binary, fmt.Sprintf("0x%x", row.Address)).CombinedOutput()
						t.Logf("llvm-symbolizer 0x%x: %s err=%v", row.Address, output, err)
					}
				}
				object.Close()
			}
			t.Logf("%s same C=%t same candidate unit keys=%t", mode, sources[0] == sources[1], reflect.DeepEqual(keys[0], keys[1]))
		})
	}
}
